texts.value: Lipid transfer and molecular tethering protein, which plays a key role in the formation of membrane contact sites between the endoplasmic reticulum and other organelles, such as late endosomes/lysosomes and mitochondria (PubMed:29097544, PubMed:31636202, PubMed:31818884, PubMed:32686675, PubMed:33912962, PubMed:40246839, PubMed:40839735, PubMed:41512824). Facilitates the exchange of lipids at membrane contact sites between the endoplasmic reticulum and organelles by mediating the transport of lipids, such as ceramide, cholesterol and phosphatidylserine (PubMed:33912962, PubMed:40839735). Also acts as a molecular glue by undergoing liquid-liquid phase separation, forming condensates that mediate stable adhesion between endoplasmic reticulum and surrounding organelles, connecting two distinct membrane-bound vesicles coupled together (PubMed:41512824). Connects the endoplasmic reticulum to late endosomes/lysosomes, facilitating the exchange of lipids, which is crucial for membrane remodeling and processes, such as neurite outgrowth (PubMed:31636202, PubMed:32686675, PubMed:33912962). PDZD8-dependent endoplasmic reticulum-mitochondria membrane tethering is essential for endoplasmic reticulum-mitochondria Ca(2+) transfer (PubMed:29097544, PubMed:31818884, PubMed:40246839). In neurons, involved in the regulation of dendritic Ca(2+) dynamics by regulating mitochondrial Ca(2+) uptake in neurons (PubMed:29097544). Mediates lysosomal vacuolation, a process during which lysosomes abnormally enlarge into large membrane-bound sacs in response to stress such as osmotic stress: acts by mediating bulk lipid transfer from the endoplasmic reticulum to lysosomes, leading to vacuole formation (PubMed:40839735). Plays an indirect role in the regulation of cell morphology and cytoskeletal organization (PubMed:21834987). May indirectly inhibit herpes simplex virus 1 infection at an early stage (PubMed:21549406)

Interacts with RAB7A; connecting the endoplasmic reticulum to late endosomes and lysosomes, where RAB7A localizes (PubMed:31636202, PubMed:33912962, PubMed:34552186, PubMed:40839735). Interacts with RAB7B; connecting the endoplasmic reticulum to late endosomes and lysosomes, where RAB7A localizes (PubMed:31636202, PubMed:40839735). Interacts with ZFYVE27; connecting the endoplasmic reticulum to late endosomes and lysosomes (PubMed:32686675). Interacts with FKBP8; connecting the endoplasmic reticulum to mitochondria (PubMed:40246839). Interacts with MSN (PubMed:21549406)
(Microbial infection) Interacts with HIV-1 Gag polyprotein p55

Localizes at mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites (PubMed:29097544, PubMed:31818884, PubMed:41512824). Localizes at late endosome- and lysosome-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites (PubMed:31636202, PubMed:32686675, PubMed:33912962, PubMed:41512824). Localizes at lysosome-endoplasmic reticulum contact sites in response to osmotic stress (PubMed:40839735)
The disordered region (448-692) mediates the formation of liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), an essential step for membrane tethering activity
The SMP-LTD domain mediates the lipid transfer activity

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry

(Microbial infection) Was initially reported to enhance infectivity of retroviruses, such as HIV-1, by stabilizing the capsid of retroviruses (PubMed:20573829, PubMed:24554657). However, it was later shown that PDZD8 is not absolutely required for HIV-1 infection, suggesting that its role in retroviral infection is probably indirect (PubMed:25771112)
